mechanism_claims.claim_text: rHsAFP1 has phenotype-level anti-Candida biofilm activity, preventing biofilm formation and enhancing caspofungin/amphotericin effects in tabled checkerboard assays.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Phenotype and synergy assays do not identify a direct molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: NMR characterization supports a plant defensin fold with an alpha helix, triple-stranded antiparallel beta sheet, and four intramolecular disulfide bonds.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Structural characterization supports defensin identity but is not itself a killing mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The gamma-core-adjacent region is implicated in antibiofilm activity because HsLin06 had BIC50 comparable to rHsAFP1 and HsLin03/HsLin05 were weaker, while other fragments were inactive up to the tested range.
direct_assay_types: synthetic fragment CTB biofilm inhibition assay
mechanism_claims.limitations: This maps an activity-associated region but does not prove a direct receptor or intracellular target.
